name: Gear-NeRF
definition: A framework for free-viewpoint rendering and tracking of dynamic scenes that leverages semantic information from image segmentation models to stratify the scene into motion-based 'gears', allowing for region-specific spatio-temporal sampling resolution.
summary: Gear-NeRF is a dynamic scene representation that stratifies 4D scenes into gear levels based on semantic motion scales, enabling adaptive spatio-temporal sampling resolution without explicit deformation fields.
